paraphrase: Complete every Play Console requirement with verifiable information: register as an organisation for financial, health, VPN or government apps; provide legal name, address, D-U-N-S number where applicable, contact details and payment profile; register the app's package names for developer verification, mandatory from 30 September 2026; and before submitting, provide all metadata, the privacy policy, the Data safety section and a working demo account with sign-in details.
